with text-ink-soft inside a Card. While contrast passes (5.97:1), the message itself doesn't have an explicit role or heading association. A screen reader user navigating by landmark may miss this message if they skip from header to the empty state without explicit announcement context. Current implementation works but explicit structure is clearer. Return real=true ONLY if this is a genuine, actionable accessibility/polish gap that a fix would meaningfully improve.
